title: VM client routes power actions and generation changes without legacy fallback
scope: Local synthetic integration fixture using the production power control and VM adapter; not live authenticated full-shell acceptance.

steps.assert: Initial session is s1 running; open power controls and choose Stop workspace
Session becomes s1 stopped; open power controls and choose Start workspace
Session becomes s2 running; click Get current access
Recorded actions are pause generation 1, start generation 1, access generation 2; no legacy calls or unexpected console/network errors
